criteria.title: Specify tagged int32, Boolean, nil and generation-checked object references without conflating a language value with C object bytes.
criteria.task: Build a representation table for INT0,BOOLfalse,NIL and REF(slot0,generation1). Derive equality and admissible operations; construct equal payload bits with different tags and reject arithmetic on Boolean values.
criteria.purpose: Equal payload bits imply equal language values or C struct bytes define guest semantics.
